x: P. Sengupta and G. Sdasyuk (1968) presented a three-tier division of India’s agricultural regions– (a) On the basis of Climatic conditions : 4 macro regions. (b) On the basis of Physiographic conditions : 11 meso (or mega) regions. (c) On the basis of crop combinations : 60 micro regions.

s: Which of the following is NOT one of Andhra Pradesh's six agroclimatic zones?

src: APPSC 2021 Horticulture Officer
s: Which of the following is NOT one of the six agro climatic zones of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Low altitude and tribal area zone
x: The sixth zone is High Altitude and Tribal Areas; a 'Low Altitude and Tribal Area' zone does not exist, so option 4 is the one that is not among the six. North Coastal, Southern and Scarce Rainfall are all genuine zones.
